verdict.rationale: Productboard offers a REST API with pagination, webhooks, and an MCP server, which enables scripted/automated access typical of CI-style workflows, but there is no evidence of an official CLI, SDK, or documented CI/headless-execution pattern (e.g., GitHub Actions, service-account/token setup for pipelines). missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage examples, official CLI/SDK for automation, service-account or non-interactive auth guidance for pipelines.
